stem:
Nina works for a restaurant. The restaurant pays her every week for the work she does. Some weeks she works more hours than other weeks.

Which statement is most likely true?

options.label: A
options.text: When Nina works fewer hours, she earns more income from the restaurant.

options.label: B
options.text: When Nina works more hours, she earns more income from the restaurant.

options.label: C
options.text: When Nina works more hours, the restaurant gets less labor from her.

options.label: D
options.text: When Nina works fewer hours, the restaurant gets more labor from her.

difficulty_rationale: The problem requires understanding the relationship between hours worked and income, which is a straightforward concept.
